experiments.note: The maintained filter operator tests cnt >= threshold below/at/above cutoff. Actual d_block_reduce_cnt and nonrandom d_activate_labels_seq run with ample capacity before insertion. Serial chain order is checked independently of active-set membership; GPU insertion order, lock contention, fences, random padding, pool exhaustion and production get_act_nodes remain untested.

conditions.parameter_change: Direct host fixture mutation; optimizer execution not claimed

experiments.note: Preserves floor(ln(8))=2 packing and the released (0,4)/(1,0) alias rather than paper ceil(log2) concatenation. Explicit addresses independently verify rebuild results and stale pre-rebuild membership. Alternate init_hash_tt_knl/init_hash_knl are outside this suite: their int smem declarations conflict with the existing char shared-memory adapter.

experiments.mechanism: Safe bounded-ring bucket overwrite, unclamped insertion counts, query count clamping and downstream frequency filtering.

conditions.execution: CPU serial execution of maintained hash/query/gather/count bodies and actual filter predicate
conditions.oracle: Explicit ring payloads and insertion counts at every address, guarded bucket allocation, clamped query lengths, host scan offsets, gathered lists, frequency maps and filtered sets including an empty query.
conditions.scan_and_copy: Host prefix scan and serial copy/filter traversal adapters; Thrust execution pending

experiments.note: Bounded bucket overflow is safe modulo-capacity behavior, distinct from linked overflow-pool exhaustion which is never provoked. Expected retained nodes use CPU serial insertion order; GPU concurrent writes can retain a different subset and remain pending. This is implementation support rather than a claim that the paper specifies these exact ring payloads. Natural-log packing remains unchanged.
